name: block
description: Whole-block visualization — draws blocks (and their outer zone faces) with field contouring and categorical labelling. 'plot item create blockface' shares the same keyword set but draws individual block faces. For the continuum field inside deformable blocks use 'bzone'.

sub_items.name: contour
sub_items.description: Colour blocks by a scalar/vector/tensor field attribute (stress, displacement, ...).

sub_items.name: label
sub_items.description: Categorical colour blocks by group, model, state, id, jointset, ...

notes: Probe live with 'plot item create <type> ?' to list top-level keywords, then 'plot item create <type> <kw> ?' for sub-options. Keyword sets here are binary-validated against 3DEC 9.0.

Related item types: block-vector — ['active', 'by-magnitude', 'clip', 'color', 'cut', 'deformation-factor', 'draw-as', 'legend', 'map', 'maxnumber', 'onboundaries', 'point-to-base', 'quality', 'range', 'scale', 'shape', 'skip', 'transparency', 'value']; block-eigen — ['active', 'clip', 'colorby', 'cut', 'deformation-factor', 'excavated', 'legend', 'map', 'mode', 'overlay', 'polygons', 'range', 'transparency', 'vectors', 'walls', 'zonefaces']; block-isosurface — field quantities (same set as block contour) + autocalc color-by color-list cut-line isovalue recalculate surface; block-zone-profile — field quantities + chart axis-x axis-y alias base-value labels legend marks name profile reversed-x reversed-y style style-line style-mark swap title type; bgroup — ['active', 'clip', 'color-list', 'cut', 'cut-line', 'deformation-factor', 'excavated', 'legend', 'map', 'overlay', 'polygons', 'range', 'transparency', 'walls']

Live-enumerated sibling item types sharing block data. block-vector draws gridpoint vector fields; block-eigen draws eigenmodes (block dynamic eigen); block-isosurface / block-zone-profile are the zone-field isosurface / profile-chart views; bgroup is a group-colored block view. Verified against live 3DEC 9.7.47 ('?' enumeration), 2026-08-14.
verification: Verified against live 3DEC 9.7.47 ('?' enumeration), 2026-08-14. Top-level keyword set is an exact match.

3DEC 7.00 Release 161 (2026-08-21): live first-slot keyword enumeration = active clip color-list contour cut deformation-factor excavated label legend map overlay polygons range transparency walls zonefaces.
